2	
3	Uses native Kontext reference latent conditioning: each input image is
4	VAE-encoded separately and chained via ReferenceLatent nodes on the
5	positive conditioning.  No pixel-space stitching hacks.
6	"""
7	
8	import os
9	import json
10	import uuid
11	import asyncio
12	import aiohttp
